instrument: City of De Soto zoning (M-1 Light Industrial) as described by the city
summary: Data centers are a permitted use in the M-1 district; the city states it cannot prohibit the use on M-1 land. Public notice is triggered only by discretionary actions such as annexation, rezoning or a special use permit. Data centers must use city water (no private wells); industrial wastewater must be treated in separate developer-funded facilities.

source.citation: City of De Soto Data Centers pages

notes: City and Astra hold senior water rights of about 8 MGD; current city peak about 1 MGD, about 2 MGD with Panasonic. City FAQ states data centers are not noisy while committing to evaluate noise mitigation, monitoring and enforcement; council asked June 4 about low-frequency noise regulation. Beale Infrastructure campus: PILOT $1M/yr Phase I. Ordinance 2697 (Sept 17, 2026) rezoned 1,118 acres south of the Panasonic plant from county RUR to city M-1 (R; relation to Digital Realty unconfirmed).
